-- Calculate TEI and check percentiles
WITH tei_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        a.accindex,
        t.vpnratio,
        t.proxycount,
        t.ipcountrynum,
        ROUND(CAST((0.4 * t.vpnratio + 0.3 * (t.proxycount::numeric / 10) + 0.3 * (t.ipcountrynum::numeric / 20)) AS numeric), 4) AS tei
    FROM account a
    JOIN profile p ON a.accindex = p.profaccref
    JOIN sessionbehavior s ON p.profkey = s.sessprofref
    JOIN networkmetrics n ON s.sessref = n.netsessref
    JOIN messaginganalysis m ON n.netkey = m.msgnetref
    JOIN technicalinfo t ON m.msgkey = t.techmsgref
)
SELECT 
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tei) AS p25,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tei) AS p50,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tei) AS p75,
    MIN(tei) AS min_tei,
    MAX(tei) AS max_tei
FROM tei_calc;
